payload.text: 0533 (vc routed it to ic, 2026-09-23; in the 3.2.1 cut under hv's ruling): nothing in Intent answers where the gate's install root resolves, so Molt copies the shim's resolution to check it. PROPOSE THE SURFACE TO vc BEFORE BUILDING. The issue expects one supported query (an intent info line, or intent bootstrap --check) that reports the home pointer, what it resolves to, whether lib/templates is under it, and whether it is the running binary's own install; measure first whether install::same_install and install::stable_root (0527) already carry the comparison.
